Class FT_Raster_Params

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<FT_Raster_Params>
org.lwjgl.util.freetype.FT_Raster_Params
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
public class FT_Raster_Params extends Struct<FT_Raster_Params> implements NativeResource
struct FT_Raster_Params {
    FT_Bitmap const * target;
    void const * source;
    int flags;
    FT_SpanFunc gray_spans;
    FT_SpanFunc black_spans;
    FT_Raster_BitTest_Func bit_test;
    FT_Raster_BitTest_Func bit_set;
    void * user;
    FT_BBox clip_box;
}
